test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six persons Hema, Rekha, Jaya, Sushma, Nimmi and Barkha are sitting in a row facing north. Barkha is not sitting beside Jaya and jaya is sitting at the extreme right. Only Hema is sitting between Nimmi and Barkha. Nimmi is not sitting beside Sushma and Jaya. Only Rekha is sitting between Sushma and Jaya. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Barkha?
solution:
The pattern follow here is:

**Given:- **Six persons Hema, Rekha, Jaya, Sushma, Nimmi and Barkha are sitting in a row facing north. 

1) Jaya is sitting at the extreme right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04a2ab35a7ddd1df6fa04110318a18124e60d19720bb0d3db163ca0562c179b4.png] 

2) Only Rekha is sitting between Sushma and Jaya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44dba266be0987ad7dcf034e400b5808ce6c7ef0a3d63a6696a06aee6023a12d.png] 

3) Nimmi is not sitting beside Sushma and Jaya.

(It means Nimmi is sitting extreme left of the row)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11e94a77b59da2424b827feb61d981d20225be741c9d22989ffb62ffa42fe946.png] 

4) Only Hema is sitting between Nimmi and Barkha. 

5) Barkha is not sitting beside Jaya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25578e7ed67021641d40a98e2e1907551c9404937935488ff3f2712025afb69f.png] 

Clearly, Sushma is sitting immediate right of Barkha.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Sushma".**
